# Growlanzo — Frontend Blueprint

**Last verified: 2026-10-20** (working tree `main` @ `59be15a` + uncommitted referral work)
**Scope:** everything a browser runs: `src/**`, `pages/**`, `index.html`, `vite.config.ts`, `scripts/build.mjs`, `server.js`, `vercel.json`, `public/_redirects`, `tailwind.config.js`, `vitest.config.ts`, `src/test/**`.
**Out of scope:** edge functions, SQL/RLS, deployment-workflow internals (only their frontend contract is noted).
**Source of truth:** the files cited inline. File counts come from [`docs/blueprint/INVENTORY.md`](INVENTORY.md), which is generated by `npm run docs:map` and guarded by `src/test/projectMap.test.ts`; this document is hand-written and must be re-verified against the tree when the map changes.
**Reading rule:** every structural claim below has a path; line numbers are from the tree at the timestamp above. Anything I could not prove is marked `UNVERIFIED`.

## 1. Runtime & build

### 1.1 Stack (as installed)

| Concern | Value | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| UI | React 19 + `react-dom` 19 | `package.json:36-37` |
| Meta-framework | **Vike 0.4.260 + vike-react 0.6.25** — one catch-all page, SSR + prerender | `package.json:40-41`, `vite.config.ts:257`, `pages/` |
| Router | `react-router-dom` 6.22 (`BrowserRouter` / `StaticRouter`), **not** Vike's file router | `pages/+Layout.tsx:18-25`, `src/app/App.tsx:191` |
| Build | Vite 8 via wrapper `node scripts/build.mjs` | `package.json:11`, `scripts/build.mjs:118` |
| Language | TS 5.3.3 with `strict:false` and every strict sub-flag off | `tsconfig.json:14-23` |
| Icons | `lucide-react` only (brand-mark allowlist, §5.3) | `package.json:35` |
| Data | direct `@supabase/supabase-js` 2.39 — no React Query/SWR/Redux | `src/lib/supabase.ts:24` |
| Telemetry | deferred Sentry, `client_errors` table, Vercel Analytics/SpeedInsights | `pages/+client.ts:6-36`, `src/lib/telemetry.ts:19-45`, `pages/+Layout.tsx:31-32` |
| Prod static server | Express 4, port 4173 | `server.js:12` |

### 1.2 How a request becomes pixels

1. **Every URL matches one Vike page.** `pages/@path/+route.ts:3` returns `'/*'`; `pages/@path/+Page.tsx:4-5` renders `<App />`. There is no second Vike page — all routing is react-router.
2. **JSX shell:** `pages/+Layout.tsx` imports `src/styles/globals.css` (`:11`) and wraps children in `BrowserRouter` on the client / `StaticRouter` on the server (`:18-25`).
3. **Head:** one global `pages/+Head.tsx` (fonts `:88-112`, viewport `:15`, OG/Twitter `:26-48`, inline critical CSS `:115-139`). Per-route titles must survive as a single SSR head — the intended fixer, `RouteHead`, is unmounted (§10 item 2).
4. **Render mode:** `ssr:true`, `prerender:true`, and `stream:{require:true, enable:false}` — Vike's Suspense-capable renderer awaited into one string, which is what makes `React.lazy` routes prerender at all (`pages/+config.ts:24,39,48`; rationale at `src/app/App.tsx:24-31`).
5. **Prerendered URL list:** exactly `PUBLIC_PRERENDER_URLS` (`pages/prerenderUrls.ts:22-75`), consumed by both `pages/+onBeforePrerenderStart.ts:23-25` and the boot-splash guard. Adding a public page to the router but not to this list is legal (it renders via SPA fallback) — it just loses static HTML and gets the splash.
6. **Build:** `scripts/build.mjs` → `vite build` (`:118`) → prune + mirror `dist/client/` into `dist/` (`:138-167`) → generate a fallback SPA shell if Vike's prerender did not run (`:242-380`) → **hard-fail** if `dist/index.html` lacks `#root`, `#vike_pageContext` or `#vike_globalContext` (white-screen guard, `:392-417`) → delete a stray `dist/404.html` (`:419-427`).
7. **Serving (three paths, same output):**
   - Vercel: `framework:"vite"`, `outputDirectory:"dist"`, rewrite `/(.*) → /index.html` (`vercel.json:2-11`), plus `public/_redirects` → `/* /index.html 200`.
   - `server.js`: static-first (`:59-62`); for a non-asset path it serves the **prerendered** `dist/client/<path>/index.html` when it exists, else `dist/index.html` (`:70-106`); `/api/*` and paths with an extension get JSON 404 (`:72-74`); `/_health` (`:65-67`); security headers incl. CSP (`:21-56`).
   - Dev: `vite` (0.0.0.0:5173, HMR disabled) (`vite.config.ts:273-282`).
8. **Boot splash (SPA-fallback flash guard):** `BOOT_SPLASH_HTML` is injected into every built HTML `<body>` by `bootSplashInjectPlugin` (`vite.config.ts:203-240`, markup `:91-160`). For any path **not** in the prerender list it clears `#root` and paints a full-screen spinner, then exposes `window.__growlancerBootReady`. Clearing `#root` is what makes vike-react do a clean client render instead of hydrating homepage DOM (React hydration error #418, `vite.config.ts:140-141`). `App.tsx:168-179` calls that hook after two `requestAnimationFrame`s. 15 s safety timeout (`vite.config.ts:158`).
9. **Theme pre-paint:** `THEME_FOUC_GUARD` is injected into `<head>` of every built HTML (`vite.config.ts:178-193,226-229`); `scripts/build.mjs:93-108` holds a byte-identical copy for the fallback shell. Storage key `growlancer-theme` must equal `ThemeContext.STORAGE_KEY` (`src/context/ThemeContext.tsx:15`); `src/test/darkThemeCoverage.test.ts` fails on drift. Root `index.html` is **not** the served document (`index.html:35-41`) — see §10 item 3.

### 1.3 Path aliases, env, chunking

- Aliases (Vite `vite.config.ts:283-296`, TS `tsconfig.json:24-35`): `@/*`, `@components`, `@features`*, `@hooks`, `@services`*, `@lib`, `@styles`, `@types`, `@layouts`, `@pages`. `*` = target directory does not exist. Real usage is inconsistent: dynamic route imports use `@pages`/`@layouts` (`src/app/App.tsx:32-84`), `useAboutPageMetrics` uses `@/lib` (`src/hooks/useAboutPageMetrics.ts:2`), everything else is relative.
- `define`: `__LEGAL_LAST_UPDATED_ISO__` from the last git commit touching the three legal pages (`vite.config.ts:16-34,253`), typed in `src/vite-env.d.ts:4`.
- Client env names only: `VITE_SUPABASE_URL`, `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` (both `.trim()`ed — a trailing newline previously broke auth, `src/lib/supabase.ts:4-8`), `VITE_APP_VERSION` (`supabase.ts:48`), `VITE_SENTRY_DSN` (`pages/+client.ts:7`), `VITE_PAYPAL_ENABLED` (`src/lib/payments.ts:10`), `VITE_RAZORPAY_CONFIG_ID` (`src/components/RazorpayCheckout.tsx:75`, `src/pages/ServiceDetailPage.tsx:310`, `src/pages/ClientWorkspacePage.tsx:521`), `VITE_AI_MODEL` (`src/components/AIChatSupport.tsx:58`, **absent from `.env.example`**).
- Chunking: `manualChunks` maps only `react-router` → `vendor-react`, `@supabase` → `vendor-supabase`, `lucide-react` → `vendor-ui` (`vite.config.ts:309-323`). React itself is not pinned to a chunk. `target:'es2020'`, `cssMinify`, `sourcemap:false`, warn at 500 KB (`:298-306`).
- Full gate: `npm run verify` = typecheck + lint + test + build (`package.json:21`).

## 2. Routing

`src/app/App.tsx` is the only route table. Page modules are `React.lazy` (`:32-157`); only `MainLayout` + `HomePage` are eager (`:20-21`). Every route is wrapped in one `<Suspense fallback={<RouteFallback />}>` (`:190`).

### 2.1 Public (inside `MainLayout`)

| Path | Component | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | `HomePage` | eager |
| `login`, `signup` | — | `<Navigate to="/?modal=login|signup" replace>` (`:195-196`); `MainLayout:32-47` opens the modal and strips the query with `history.replaceState` |
| `how-it-works`, `features`, `categories`, `pricing`, `about`, `philosophy`, `contact`, `help-center`, `safety`, `guidelines`, `status`, `terms`, `privacy`, `escrow-policy`, `refund-policy`, `cookies` | one page each (`src/pages/*`) | all prerendered |
| `internships`, `careers` | `InternshipsPage` | two URLs, one component (`:203-204`) |
| `projects/:projectId` | `ProjectDetailsPage` | dynamic, client-only |
| `payment/:outcome` | `PaymentCallbackPage` | `success`/`cancel` prerendered |
| `freelancers`, `services`, `contests`, `contests/:contestId` | `FreelancersSearchPage`, `ServicesCatalogPage`, `ContestsPage`, `ContestDetailPage` | |
| `freelancer/:freelancerId` | `PublicFreelancerProfilePage` | |
| `services/:serviceId` | `ServiceDetailPage` | |
| `dashboard/help-center`, `client/help-center` | `HelpCenterPage dashboard` | same page inside both shells (`:309,350`) |

### 2.2 Standalone (outside `MainLayout`)

| Path | Component |
|---|---|
| `certificate`, `certificate/:code`, `verify-certificate`, `verify-certificate/:code` | `CertificateVerifyPage` (`:227-230`) |
| `auth/callback` · `auth/email-confirm` · `auth/verify-email` | `AuthCallbackPage`, `EmailConfirmPage`, `VerifyEmailPage` |
| `waitlist` | `WaitlistPage` |
| `debug` | `DebugPage`, dev-only, `import.meta.env.DEV` (`:155-157,238`) |
| `*` | `NotFoundPage` (`:385`) |

### 2.3 Guarded shells

| Area | Prefix | Guard | Layout | Children |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Onboarding | `/onboarding`, `/onboarding/freelancer`, `/onboarding/client` | `ProtectedRoute` (no roles on `/onboarding`; legacy role paths keep `allowedRoles`) (`:241-268`) | none | one `OnboardingPage` |
| Freelancer | `/dashboard` | `ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={['freelancer']}` (`:271-277`) | `DashboardLayout` | 30 route elements = index + 29 (`:279-309`) |
| Client | `/client` | `ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={['client']}` (`:314-320`) | `ClientDashboardLayout` | 26 route elements = index + 25 (`:322-350`) |
| Admin | `/admin` | `AdminAuthGuard` (`:354-360`) | `AdminDashboardLayout` | 18 route elements = index + 17 (`:362-378`) |

Redirect-only routes (bookmark compatibility): `/dashboard/overview`, `/dashboard/settings`, `/dashboard/ai-subscription`, `/dashboard/inbox`, `/dashboard/dispute-resolution`, `/client/ai-subscription`, `/client/inbox` — all `<Navigate replace>`.
Three routes reuse another area's page: `/client/notifications` → `NotificationsCenterPage`; `/client/verification` → `IdentityVerificationPage`; `/client/support-tickets` → `SupportTicketsPage`.

### 2.4 Guards and post-auth routing

- **`ProtectedRoute`** (`src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx`) runs, in order: `LayoutSkeleton` while `isLoading` (`:234-236`); unauthenticated → `/?modal=login` (`:239-244`); email-verification check — OAuth providers (`github`, `linkedin_oidc`) always pass, email signups need `email_confirmed_at`, a stale session is force-cleared (`:177-231,246-254`); **server-side role re-read** from `profiles.role` + `profiles_private.suspended_at`, suspended users are signed out and reloaded to login (`:100-164`); `onboardingCompleted === false` → `/onboarding` (`:265-269`); `allowedRoles` mismatch → `getDashboardRoute()` (`:272-280`).
- **`AdminAuthGuard`** (`src/components/AdminAuthGuard.tsx`) checks a Supabase session, reads `profiles` + `profiles_private` by id, falls back to a lookup **by email** when not admin (`:99-121`), and treats either `profiles_private.is_admin` or `profiles.role === 'admin'` as admin (`:95-97`). While checking it renders a dark spinner; not authorized → `AdminLoginPage` inline (`:153-165`). It persists `growlancer_admin_session` in localStorage (`:13-41`) and exports `isAdminLoggedIn`, `getAdminSession`, `adminLogout` (`:170-191`). This is a **UX gate only** — every admin read/write goes through the `admin-data` edge function, which re-verifies the caller (`src/lib/adminDataProxy.ts:1-11`).
- **`AuthContext`** owns `getDashboardRoute(role?)` (`src/context/AuthContext.tsx:1065-1078`: freelancer→`/dashboard`, client→`/client`, admin→`/admin`, else `/`).
- **`getPostAuthPath(profile)`** (`src/lib/authAction.ts:30-43`) is the shared post-auth policy: no profile or `onboardingCompleted === false` → `/onboarding`; else role dashboard. `redirectAfterAuth()` does a **full-page** `window.location.replace` (`:53-55`) so `AuthContext` re-initialises from the persisted session instead of racing `ProtectedRoute`. Used by `AuthCallbackPage` (`:643,704`) and `VerifyEmailPage` (`:109`). `shouldRedirectToAuthCallback()` (`:104-111`) rescues Supabase redirects that land on `/` with `?code=`/`#access_token=` and bounces them to `/auth/callback` (`AuthContext.tsx:430`).

### 2.5 Route constants discipline — ⚠️ weaker than it looks

`src/routes.ts` exports `ROUTES` (`:4-139`), `getRoute()` (`:145-158`), `NAVIGATION` (`:161-186`) and a second `PLATFORM_CONFIG` (`:189-194`). Reality:

- **Only 5 files import `ROUTES`**: `MainLayout.tsx:4`, `NotFoundPage.tsx:3`, `HomePage.tsx:4`, `ProjectDetailsPage.tsx:5`, `PaymentCallbackPage.tsx:5` — and they use only public paths (`HOME`, `FEATURES`, `CATEGORIES`, `PRICING`, `HOW_IT_WORKS`, `HELP_CENTER`, `SERVICES`, `FREELANCERS`, `CONTESTS`, `ABOUT`, `CONTACT`, `INTERNSHIPS`, `PHILOSOPHY`, `SAFETY`, `GUIDELINES`, `STATUS`).
- `App.tsx` uses **string literals** for every route; sidebars (`DashboardLayout.tsx:60-108`, `ClientDashboardLayout.tsx:55-100`, `AdminDashboardLayout.tsx:38-64`), `SiteFooter.tsx:48+`, `dashboardSection.ts:33-70` and `RouteHead.tsx:53-244` all use literals too.
- `ROUTES.FREELANCER.*` / `ROUTES.CLIENT.*` / `ROUTES.ADMIN.*` have **zero consumers**. Several are wrong: `FREELANCER.TICKETS` = `/dashboard/tickets` and `CLIENT.TICKETS` = `/client/tickets` (real routes are `/dashboard/support-tickets`, `/client/support-tickets`).
- Routes with no constant: `/report`, `/refund-policy`, `/projects/:id`, `/payment/:outcome`, `/waitlist`, `/debug`, `/admin/users|projects|…`.
- `getRoute()`, `NAVIGATION` and `routes.ts`'s `PLATFORM_CONFIG` are unreferenced (`FEE_PERCENTAGE`/`PRO_PRICE` have no readers). The live fee config is `src/lib/config.ts:4-79` (`PLATFORM_CONFIG.fees.platform_percentage = 5`, `premium_monthly.price = 299`), imported by `src/lib/teamProjects.ts:11` and `EscrowPayPalPayment.tsx:21`.

**Rule for new work:** register the route in `App.tsx` *and*, if it is public/crawlable, in `pages/prerenderUrls.ts`; add the nav entry in the area's layout; add the header label in `src/lib/dashboardSection.ts`. Do not add to `ROUTES` expecting it to take effect.

## 4. State & data layer

### 4.1 Provider stack (outermost → innermost)

`ErrorBoundary` → `ThemeProvider` → `AuthProvider` → `CurrencyProvider` → `I18nProvider` → `ToastProvider` → `ScrollToTop` + `Suspense`/`Routes` → `CookieConsent` + `OAuthReturnNotice` (`src/app/App.tsx:183-397`). `CurrencyProvider` calls `useAuth` (`CurrencyContext.tsx:64`), so it must stay inside `AuthProvider`. No global store exists.

### 4.2 `AuthContext` (`src/context/AuthContext.tsx`, 1 111 lines)

| Owns | Detail |
|---|---|
| `user: AuthUser \| null`, `supabaseUser`, `session`, `isLoading` | `:124-127` |
| Derived | `role` (defaults `'freelancer'`), `isAuthenticated = !!user && !!session` (`:1089-1090`) |
| Auth surface | `signInWithOAuth(provider, role?)` (`:976-1039`), `logout()` (`:1041-1063`) — **no email/password, no `login()`** |
| Routing | `getDashboardRoute(role?)` (`:1065-1078`) |
| Profile lifecycle | `ensureUserProfile` (fetch → create with role/referral, duplicate-creation guard) (`:129-176`), auto-create for OAuth users (`:244-297`, safety net `:325-343`) |
| Cross-tab sync | `BroadcastChannel('growlancer_auth_sync')`, messages `AUTH_SIGNED_IN` / `SIGNED_OUT` / `PROFILE_UPDATED` / `SESSION_REFRESHED` (`:22-48,636-695`) |
| Realtime | one `profiles` channel `profile_updates:<id>`; `DELETE` → immediate sign-out, `INSERT/UPDATE` → refetch with 3 retries; **skipped for `role==='admin'`** to avoid fighting `AdminAuthGuard` (`:697-761`) |
| Liveness | 60 s profile-existence poll + visibility re-check, 8 consecutive failures before sign-out (`:772-800`), inactivity timeout with activity events (`:900-974`) |
| Session hygiene | stale-session detection via `isStaleSessionError` → `clearSupabaseAuthStorage()` (`:188-198`); referral deferred processing (`:367-404`) |
| OAuth breadcrumbs | `beginOAuthAttempt`/`clearOAuthAttempt` (`:11,1000,1049`), role/ref/provider kept in localStorage across the redirect (`:982-993`) |

`getSession()` is treated as cache, `getUser()` as truth (`LoginModal.tsx:29-49`, `SignupModal.tsx:46-60`).

### 4.3 `src/lib/supabase.ts` (538 lines)

- Static typed client created at module load; **throws** if either env var is missing (`:12-14,24`). `flowType:'implicit'` is deliberate and load-bearing for cross-device email links (`:29-39`).
- Global fetch wrapper applies a 15 s `AbortController` and **must not** throw on non-2xx — supabase-js needs the status (`:50-69`).
- Helpers: `getClient()` (`:74`), `clearSupabaseAuthStorage()` (removes every `sb-*auth-token*` key, `:92-106`), `isStaleSessionError()` (`:114-127`).
- `TableName` union incl. extended tables missing from generated types (`:135-166`); `tables.*` typed table helpers (`:178-222`) — most code still calls `supabase.from('x')` directly.
- `uniqueChannelName(base, scope)` **must** be used instead of a static channel name; re-subscribing an existing channel name throws and unmounts the page (`:243-246`).
- `realtimeChannels.*` — one factory per table, each name unique (`:248-277`).
- `RpcName` union + `dbFunctions` wrapper object (`:280-536`). Money writers are deliberately absent with comments explaining the revocations (`:314-318,346-349,404-407,514-517`).
- `Database` is generated and present (`src/types/supabase.ts`).

### 4.5 Hooks

| Hook | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `useProStatus` | fetch current subscription via `subscriptionService`, live `subscriptions` channel, trial-expiry `setTimeout`; `isPro` = live row, profile flag only as first-render fallback (`:46-84`) |
| `useReferralsData` | 3 parallel reads (stats, referrals, `get_grow_coin_leaderboard` RPC), live `profiles_private` (code), `referral_stats`, `referrals` channels, toast on failure (`:36-163`) |
| `useAboutPageMetrics` | `get_public_platform_metrics` RPC, 60 s poll + visibility refresh, live `profiles` + `reviews` only — **escrow is deliberately not subscribed** because RLS hides it from anonymous visitors (`:137-186`) |
| `useGrowCoinBalance` | `grow_coin_ledger` live balance |
| `useCategories` / `useCountries` / `useIndustries` | reference data + live table channel; `useCountries:52-60` uses a per-instance channel id |

### 4.6 Caching, loading and error conventions

- **Cache:** `CacheManager` only (`TTL 6 s`, LRU, max 200 → evict to 150, `cacheManager.ts:7-13`). Services call `CacheManager.invalidate('<prefix>')` after mutations (`dataService.ts:113-114`). No HTTP cache layer, no SWR.
- **Loading:** page-level → `<PageSkeleton />` imported from `src/components/PageSkeleton.tsx` (`:20-26`, ~30 call sites, e.g. `OverviewPage.tsx:397`); form pages use `<PageSkeleton showStats={false} cards={false} />`; route-level suspense → `<RouteFallback />` (`LoadingSkeleton.tsx:279-302`); auth guard → `<LayoutSkeleton />` (`ProtectedRoute.tsx:235`). A bare spinner is acceptable only inside `ModalShell`-hosted flows.
- **Errors:** every `catch` either shows `toast.error(...)` or writes `captureError(...)`; user-facing copy is short title + actionable sentence. Network/validation failures must not blank the page.
- **Rule (CLAUDE.md):** no `alert()`/`window.confirm()`; use `ConfirmModal`. No empty `catch {}`.
- **Toast:** `useToast()` from `src/components/Toast.tsx:192-198` — `success/error/warning/info/loading`, default durations 4 s / 6 s / 5 s / 4 s / ∞, max 5 stacked, action button supported (`:56-84`). Container is `fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-[9999]` (`:104`).
- **Telemetry:** `captureInfo` (log only) and `captureError` (log + non-dev insert into `client_errors`, `telemetry.ts:19-64`). `ErrorBoundary` shows `ERR-<ts>-<rand>` and logs `eventId` (`ErrorBoundary.tsx:21-49`); it is mounted **twice** (`App.tsx:183`, `pages/+Layout.tsx:28`).

## 5. UI system

### 5.1 Palette, tokens and dark mode

- Tailwind custom tokens: `cream #FFF8EE`, `ink #0F172A`, `muted #475569`, `primary` emerald scale, `secondary` orange scale, container paddings, animations (`tailwind.config.js:12-88`).
- `globals.css` base layer defines `--default-border` and chart tokens used by SVG (`:12-36`), forces `border-color` for every element (`:38-40`), body `bg-cream text-slate-900` (`:48-55`), `color-scheme` + native control colours (`:60-98`), and a 240 ms colour transition under `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` (`:103-112`).
- **Dark mode is a palette remap, not `dark:` variants.** `html.dark` + `.dark :where(.bg-white){…}` overrides for surfaces, alpha spellings, borders, text and tinted status surfaces (`:569-~1000`), plus a separate **outside-the-layer** block for state variants (`html.dark :where(.hover\:bg-slate-50):hover`, `:1142-1364`) because Tailwind rewrites/orders rules inside `@layer utilities` (`:1109-1141`). Never add a new palette class without adding it to this remap — `src/test/darkThemeCoverage.test.ts` classifies every colour utility in `src/` and fails on an unremapped token or a wrong rule shape.
- Admin console is intentionally dark in both themes (`globals.css:557-560`); it uses `.on-dark-surface { color-scheme:dark }` for native pickers (`:147-149`).
- Floating menus need the `menu-surface` hook or they blend into the card behind (`:1417-1427`, guarded by `darkFormControls.test.ts`).

### 5.2 Typography

`font-sans` = Satoshi, `font-display` = Cabinet Grotesk (`tailwind.config.js:43-46`). Fonts are loaded by **three identical declarations**: `pages/+Head.tsx:88-112` (prerendered pages), `index.html:19-28` (Vite shell), `scripts/build.mjs:327-340` (fallback shell). Rules: one Fontshare request **per family** (a combined URL silently serves one), and only published weights (Satoshi 400/500/700/900; Cabinet 400/500/700/800/900). `typographyFonts.test.ts` enforces all of it; `cspFontAllowList.test.ts` keeps `style-src`/`font-src` byte-identical across `vercel.json`, `server.js`, `nginx.conf` and `+Head.tsx`.

### 5.3 Icons

`lucide-react` only. Hand-drawn `<svg>` is banned in the migrated files and the removed path strings are asserted absent (`iconPackConsolidation.test.ts:23-62`). Brand marks are the only allowlist, counted exactly: `OAuthButtons` 2, `PayPalCheckout` 1, `SiteFooter` 3, `CertificateVerifyPage` 1, `ReferralsPage` 2, `ClientReferralsPage` 3 (`:75-89`) — plus the four inline marks in `ReferralInviteCard.tsx:26-72` (WhatsApp, LinkedIn, X, email), which the allowlist does not enumerate; new files are simply not covered by it.

### 5.6 A11y and responsive conventions

- Every dismissible overlay closes on Escape and restores body scroll (`ModalShell.tsx:58-77`, `MainLayout.tsx:20-29`); icon-only buttons carry `aria-label` (`ModalShell.tsx:102`, `Toast.tsx:171`, `ReferralInviteCard.tsx:271,287`); live regions where content changes without navigation (`ReferralInviteCard.tsx:225-228` `aria-live="polite"`); tooltips use `role="tooltip"` (`ProBadge.tsx:41`).
- Known gaps (documented in `docs/AUDIT_FINDINGS_FRONTEND.md` A11Y-001/002/003/004): no `role="dialog"`/focus trap in `ModalShell`, no live region on the toast viewport, no skip link, validation errors not wired with `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby`. New work should not copy those gaps.
- Responsive: mobile-first utilities; breakpoints actually used as design decisions are `sm` (640), `lg` (1024, sidebar appears), `xl` (1280, full public nav), `2xl` (1536, wider gutters). Long IDs/text use `break-words` + `overflow-x-hidden` on the dashboard main column (`DashboardLayout.tsx:775`).
- The cookie banner publishes its measured height as `--consent-banner-h` (ResizeObserver, removed on consent) and both sidebars subtract it: `h-[calc(100vh-var(--consent-banner-h,0px))]` (`CookieConsent.tsx:128-153`, `DashboardLayout.tsx:527`, `ClientDashboardLayout.tsx:436`). Contract locked by `src/test/consentBannerSpacing.test.tsx`.

## 6. Realtime

**Rules**
1. One channel per subscriber; always a unique name — `uniqueChannelName()` (`supabase.ts:243-246`) or a `realtimeChannels.*` factory (`:248-277`). Reusing a static name crashes the page (`:230-242`).
2. Cleanup is mandatory: `channel.unsubscribe()` in the effect's return (`useReferralsData.ts:159-162`); public-metric style subscribers also `await supabase.removeChannel(channel)` (`useAboutPageMetrics.ts:172-185`).
3. Filter by owner id whenever the table is owner-scoped — an unfiltered subscription on a protected table silently delivers nothing.
4. Never subscribe to a table the current visitor cannot `SELECT`: anonymous marketing pages subscribe to `profiles` and `reviews` only; `escrow` is intentionally excluded (`useAboutPageMetrics.ts:145-153`).
5. Channel status is surfaced as UI where it matters (`live` flag in `ReferralInviteCard.tsx:214-220`).

## 7. Forms, money, dates, uploads, external widgets

### 7.1 Forms
- Controlled inputs with local `useState`; no form library, no schema validation.
- Field markup is **hand-rolled and inconsistent**: `label` + `input` with `w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-200 outline-none` and paddings varying between `px-3 py-2.5` and `px-4 py-3` (`ClientPostProjectPage.tsx:239-343`). `globals.css:132-138` defines `.input` / `.card` / `.btn-*`, but most pages do not use them.
- Validation is imperative before submit, surfaced through `toast.error('Validation Error', '…')` (`ClientPostProjectPage.tsx:104-124`) plus inline text; shared helpers: `validateEmail`, `validateRequired`, `validateMinLength`, `isValidUuid`, `validateBudget`, `validatePassword` (`src/utils/validation.ts:15-196`). Put an `isValidUuid` guard in front of every `.eq('id', urlParam)`.
- Submit flow: `setSaving(true)` → service call → `toast.success/error` → `navigate`/`refresh` → `finally setSaving(false)`.

### 7.2 Money display
- **Single formatter:** `formatCurrency(amount, currency?, locale?)` and `formatCompactCurrency` in `src/lib/currency.ts:366-437`; `formatBudgetRange` for min/max (`utils/date.ts:241-249`); `safeNumber` before formatting (`utils/date.ts:60-63`).
- React components should read `useCurrency()` (`CurrencyContext.tsx:108-111`) → `{ currency, locale, format, formatCompact, symbol, source, countryCode }`, resolved as profile country → browser detection → INR (`:74-103`). `format` does **not** convert (`:99-101`) — see the FX hazard in §10 item 1.
- Fee maths: `calculatePlatformFee` / `calculateTotalWithFee` / `calculateFreelancerAmount` (`config.ts:84-95`). Client pays 5 % on top; freelancer receives the full bid.
- Payments must never read an amount the client supplies for fulfilment; the UI sends ids/references, edge functions derive values (`CLAUDE.md` Security §1). `RazorpayCheckout` sends `orderData` but renders the amount the server returns (`RazorpayCheckout.tsx:62-69`).

### 7.3 Dates
`src/utils/date.ts`: `safeFormatDate` / `safeFormatDateTime` / `safeFormatTime` (return `''` on bad input, `:8-54`), `formatDate`/`getRelativeTime` for feeds, `safeString`/`safeLower` for DB text (`:71-84`). Never call `toLocaleDateString` on an unguarded DB value.

### 7.4 File uploads
- `fileUploadService.uploadFile(file, contractId, description)` posts `FormData` to `functions/v1/file-upload` with an explicit `Authorization: Bearer <session.access_token>` (`fileUpload.ts:21-65`); `getContractFiles` (`:68+`).
- `portfolioImageUpload.upload(file, folder)` backs `ImageUpload.tsx:124`; `avatarUpload` backs profile/avatar; `avatarPack` builds derived sizes.
- Limit announced in config: 25 MB (`config.ts:17`); storage limit is 50 MiB server-side. Do not raise client limits without confirming the bucket policy.

### 7.5 External widgets / gateways
- Razorpay: `razorpayService.createOrder` → `openCheckout` with `config_id` from `VITE_RAZORPAY_CONFIG_ID`, amount in **paise** (`RazorpayCheckout.tsx:62-70`); script/iframe allowed by CSP in `server.js:46-51` and `vercel.json:23`.
- PayPal: fully implemented but gated by `PAYMENTS_CONFIG.paypalEnabled` (`payments.ts:9-11`), return URL handled by `token`/`PayerID` query params (`PayPalCheckout.tsx:34-45`).
- AI: `AIChatSupport` streams from `functions/v1/ai-assistant` (SSE), shows a usage meter for free freelancers only, hides it for Pro (`AIChatSupport.tsx:46-72`); `AIGenerateModal` invokes `ai-writer` and must read errors from `error.context`, not `data` (documented fix in CLAUDE.md Oct 5).
- Two invocation styles exist: `supabase.functions.invoke(name,{body})` (JWT automatic — `adminDataProxy.ts`, `identityVerification.ts`, `subscriptionHelpers.ts`, `HomePage.tsx`) and raw `fetch(.../functions/v1/<fn>, {Authorization})` where streaming/FormData is needed (`fileUpload.ts`, `razorpay.ts`, `paypal.ts`, `withdrawal.ts`, `aiMatching.ts`, `AIChatSupport.tsx`).

## 8. Testing conventions (UI)

Config: jsdom, globals on, `src/test/setup.ts` (adds `scrollIntoView`, silences console unless `VITEST_VERBOSE`), `pool:'threads'` + `maxWorkers:1` because `forks` hangs on some Windows setups (`vitest.config.ts:5-25`). Coverage is scoped to six lib modules only (`:17-24`).

Two families of tests exist:

1. **Behavioural RTL tests** — wrap the component in the providers it needs, usually `MemoryRouter` + `ToastProvider`, stub browser APIs (`clipboard`, `ResizeObserver`, `matchMedia`), mock `react-router-dom` only partially, and `vi.mock('../lib/supabase')` so no network is possible. Canonical example: `src/test/referralInviteCard.test.tsx:1-80`. Router-dependent pages: `consentBannerSpacing.test.tsx:6-12`, `waitlistPage.test.tsx:8-23`, `mobileMenuEscape.test.tsx:8-17`.
2. **Source-contract tests** — read files with `node:fs` and assert invariants (fonts identical in 3 places, CSP hosts, palette coverage, no raw `<svg>`, no fake copy). These are the repo's dominant guard style; every one carries a negative control or an explicit reason comment.

A new component test should look like:

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ToastProvider } from '../components/Toast';
import { MyComponent } from '../components/MyComponent';

afterEach(cleanup);

it('does the user-visible thing', async () => {
  render(<MemoryRouter><ToastProvider><MyComponent /></ToastProvider></MemoryRouter>);
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /save/i }));
  expect(await screen.findByText(/saved/i)).toBeTruthy();
});
```

Frontend/UI guards that lock behaviour (49 test files total):

| Test | Locks |
|---|---|
| `iconPackConsolidation.test.ts` | lucide-only in migrated files; exact brand-`<svg>` counts |
| `typographyFonts.test.ts` | 3 identical font declarations, published weights, `font-*` usage coverage |
| `darkThemeCoverage.test.ts` · `darkFormControls.test.ts` · `themeProvider.test.tsx` | every light token remapped or excused; state rules outside `:where()`/layer; native control + `<option>` colours; `menu-surface` hook; pre-paint guard in built HTML; storage key; hydration contract |
| `cspFontAllowList.test.ts` | no Google Fonts; Fontshare hosts identical in `vercel.json`/`server.js`/`nginx.conf`/`+Head` |
| `consentBannerSpacing.test.tsx` | `--consent-banner-h` set while banner visible, removed on consent |
| `authRouteSurface.test.ts` · `oauthOnlyAuthSurface.test.ts` | every prerendered `/auth/*` has a route; removed password URLs appear in neither; no password-login surface anywhere |
| `countrySelectContract.test.tsx` | India-only selectable; other countries only join waitlist |
| `mobileMenuEscape.test.tsx` | Escape closes the public mobile menu |
| `errorBoundary.test.tsx` | fallback screen (never blank) + Retry recovers |
| `waitlistPage.test.tsx` | waitlist success/failure copy; no fake success |
| `earningsChart.test.tsx` | `EarningsChart` render/series behaviour |
| `truthfulPlanClaims.test.ts` · `publicMetricsHonesty.test.ts` | no undeliverable Premium claims on plan surfaces; homepage social proof from the live RPC, no hardcoded count |
| `referralCode.test.ts` / `referralShare.test.ts` / `referralInviteCard.test.tsx` | code format/normalisation, share text/intents, copy-vs-link separation |
| `projectMap.test.ts` | `INVENTORY.md` freshness |
| non-UI guards | migrations/RPC/CORS/secrets/service-role/column-grant tests — see the rest of `src/test/` |

## 9. How to add X (file-by-file)

### 9.1 A public marketing page
1. `src/pages/MyThingPage.tsx` — export `MyThingPage`, default export optional. Copy the shell from `AboutPage.tsx` (`max-w-[100rem] px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 2xl:px-12`, `font-display` headings, `bg-cream`).
2. `src/app/App.tsx` — lazy import next to the other public pages (`:40-53`) and a `<Route path="my-thing" element={<MyThingPage />} />` inside the `/` `MainLayout` block (`:197-223`).
3. `pages/prerenderUrls.ts` — add `'/my-thing'` (`:22-75`). This is what gives it static HTML and suppresses the boot splash.
4. `src/components/SiteFooter.tsx` (and `MainLayout` nav if it belongs there) — literal `<Link to="/my-thing">`.
5. `src/components/RouteHead.tsx` — add a `ROUTE_RULE` **only after** mounting the component (§10 item 2); today it renders nowhere.

### 9.2 A dashboard page for both roles
1. Freelancer page in `src/pages/dashboard/XxxPage.tsx`, client page in `src/pages/ClientXxxPage.tsx` (separate files; there is no shared screen abstraction).
2. `src/app/App.tsx` — lazy import in the right block (`:86-131`) and a child route under `/dashboard` (`:279-309`) or `/client` (`:322-350`).
3. `src/layouts/DashboardLayout.tsx:60-108` (or `ClientDashboardLayout.tsx:55-100`) — add `{ id, path, icon, label }` to the right group; import the lucide icon at the top.
4. `src/lib/dashboardSection.ts:33-70` — add the exact path → title mapping (otherwise the header falls back to a title-cased last URL segment).
5. Page body: `useAuth()` → `PageSkeleton` while loading → `useEffect` fetch from a service → `EmptyState` when empty → `toast` for errors. Register realtime in the same effect with cleanup.
6. If the page has its own modal, use `ModalShell` (not a raw `fixed inset-0` div).

### 9.3 A modal
1. `src/components/XxxModal.tsx` — `function XxxModal({isOpen,onClose,...})` and return `<ModalShell isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="…" maxWidth="max-w-lg">…</ModalShell>` (pattern: `ConfirmModal.tsx:66-104`).
2. Destructive confirmations: `ConfirmModal` with `variant="danger"` and an async `onConfirm` so the internal loading state holds.
3. Escape/backdrop/scroll-lock come free; do not re-implement them. For irreversible actions pass `closeOnBackdrop={false}`.
4. Mount it from the page inside `ToastProvider` (already global), not inside `<Suspense>`.

### 9.4 A data-backed feature (service + hook + realtime)
1. Types: local interfaces in the service module (or `src/types/`), not in the page.
2. `src/lib/xxxService.ts` — object export, methods return `{ success, data?, error? }` or throw; `captureError` on failure; `CacheManager.invalidate('<key>')` after writes (`dataService.ts:88-120` is the template). If it touches money or admin data, call the edge function instead (§7.5).
3. `src/hooks/useXxx.ts` — state + `loading` + `refresh` + effect that loads on `userId` change and subscribes with `realtimeChannels.<table>(scope)` or `uniqueChannelName`, returning the unsubscribe.
4. RPCs: add the name to `RpcName` and a wrapper in `dbFunctions` (`supabase.ts:280-536`) rather than calling `supabase.rpc` inline with `as any`.
5. Page consumes the hook; render `PageSkeleton`/`EmptyState`; surface errors via toast.
6. Tests: one RTL test with the Supabase module mocked; one source guard if the feature is a business rule (referral honesty, plan claims, metrics honesty patterns).

### 9.5 A form
1. Local state per field; copy the field classes from the nearest page in the same area.
2. Validate before submit with `src/utils/validation.ts` helpers; show `toast.error('Validation Error', …)` for the first failure and inline text for field-level detail.
3. Disable the submit `Button` with `loading`; never navigate away before the service resolves.
4. Use `useCurrency().symbol` for money prefixes and `formatCurrency` for summaries.
5. Destructive cancel/leave → `ConfirmModal`.

### 9.6 A new shared component
1. `src/components/Xxx.tsx`, named export + `export default` only if an existing importer needs it.
2. Props interface documented with a short header comment; no context reads unless unavoidable.
3. Reuse `Button`, `EmptyState`, `ModalShell`, `PageSkeleton`; use `lucide-react` icons only (brand marks go on the allowlist).
4. Use remapped palette tokens (`bg-white`, `bg-slate-50`, `text-slate-900`, `border-slate-200`) — never an arbitrary `bg-[#F8FAFC]`; add any new token to `globals.css` and `darkThemeCoverage.test.ts` excuses. Add an RTL test if it has behaviour, a source guard if it encodes a product rule.

## 11. Highest-leverage facts

1. **One Vike page, one react-router table.** `pages/@path/+route.ts` matches `/*`; add routes only in `src/app/App.tsx`. `pages/prerenderUrls.ts` is the only prerender list that matters.
2. **`scripts/build.mjs` is the build.** It mirrors `dist/client → dist`, regenerates a fallback shell when prerender is skipped, and hard-fails on missing `#vike_pageContext` — a "missing index.html"/white-screen deploy is a build-script problem, not a React problem.
3. **Boot order is scripted:** theme class in `<head>` → boot splash clears `#root` on non-prerendered paths → React renders → `__growlancerBootReady` after 2 rAF. Touching any of the three breaks first paint.
4. **`ProtectedRoute` is the role/onboarding gate; `getPostAuthPath` is the destination policy.** `AdminAuthGuard` is UX only — every admin capability is re-checked by `admin-data`.
5. **Dark mode is a CSS palette remap**, so a new colour class is a dark-mode bug until it is remapped; `darkThemeCoverage.test.ts` is the enforcement.
6. **Realtime needs a unique channel name + unconditional unsubscribe**, and never subscribe to a table the current visitor cannot read.
7. **Money display funnels through `useCurrency()`/`formatCurrency`** — and that path currently changes the symbol, not the value (§10 item 1).
8. **`npm run verify`** (typecheck + lint + test + build) is the expected gate; `npm run docs:map` refreshes `INVENTORY.md`, which `projectMap.test.ts` guards.
